UPDATE auth.users SET
            raw_app_meta_data = $3::jsonb,
            raw_user_meta_data = $4::jsonb,
            phone = NULLIF($5, ''),
            phone_confirmed_at = $6::timestamptz,
            is_anonymous = $7,
            updated_at = $8::timestamptz
         WHERE instance_id = $1::uuid AND id = $2::uuid
